name: Brick / block / mortar material shortage or late delivery
description: Stock-out or late delivery of bricks, blocks, cement or sand halts masons.
evidence_note: M01 (India, brick-wall site): material shortages RII 0.777 and identified as the most influential factor on the site; M06 (India): availability of resources ranked first. Survey rankings show importance, not probability.

name: Tools and equipment delay
description: Scaffolding, mixers, hoists or hand tools unavailable when needed.
evidence_note: M01: tools delay reported with material shortage as the most influential factors at the observed site.

name: Labour absenteeism or shortage
description: Fewer masons or helpers available than planned.
evidence_note: M07 (India): site amenities and welfare factors affect workforce productivity; M15 (Brazil): lack of qualified labour among top delay causes; M01 (India) lists labour factors.

name: Unskilled or unqualified labour
description: Crew skill below what the wall specification needs, lowering output and raising defects.
evidence_note: M15: unqualified labour ranked among the top delay causes (Brazil); M14: worker-perceived productivity factors (Indonesia).

name: Poor planning or unrealistic scheduling
description: Sequence, resource loading or duration in the plan is not achievable.
evidence_note: M01 (India): poor work planning RII 0.791 and unrealistic scheduling RII 0.791.

name: Unsafe conditions or work at height
description: Stoppage or slowdown due to unsafe working conditions, particularly at height.
evidence_note: M01 (India): unsafe working conditions RII 0.809 (highest in that table) and working at heights RII 0.764.

name: Rain / monsoon stoppage
description: Rain or extreme weather stops or slows outdoor masonry.
evidence_note: R08 (India, cold regions): snowfall, rainfall and low temperature are top delay factors; M01 lists weather conditions among the ranked factors. Building studies in the notes rank weather below labour and material.

name: Rework due to workmanship or defects
description: Rejected or redone wall sections.
evidence_note: M03 (Palestine): rework cost lowers brick-work productivity (Y = 34.36 - 1.71X); M15 (Brazil): rework ranked first among delay causes.

name: Payment delay
description: Delayed payments to contractor or labour cause slowdown or stoppage.
evidence_note: M01 (India): payment delay RII 0.773.

name: Design changes or incomplete documentation
description: Drawing changes, clarifications or missing details interrupt work.
evidence_note: M06 (India): frequent design changes and scope clarity among significant productivity factors; M13 (Saudi Arabia): design quality affects delay.

name: Inadequate supervision or monitoring of workers
description: Masons and helpers work without effective supervision, targets or monitoring, so output and quality fall.
evidence_note: M10 (Middle East): inadequate workers' supervision RII 0.816; M01 (India): poor or no supervision method RII 0.759; M01 (India): incompetent supervisors RII 0.759; M14 (Indonesia): lack of supervision RII 0.72. Survey rankings show importance, not probability.

name: Low motivation, morale or labour turnover
description: Poor morale, dissatisfaction or workers leaving reduce effort and continuity of the crew.
evidence_note: M01 (India): low labour morale/commitment RII 0.736; M01 (India): lack of empowerment RII 0.732 (related); M10 (Middle East): poor workers' motivation RII 0.709; M14 (Indonesia): changing jobs RII 0.701 (related). Survey rankings show importance, not probability.

name: Inadequate wages or incentives
description: Low pay or no incentives lower commitment and make workers move to other sites.
evidence_note: M10 (Middle East): lack of incentive schemes RII 0.783; M01 (India): little or no financial rewards RII 0.777; M10 (Middle East): remuneration scale RII 0.738; M14 (Indonesia): low salary RII 0.735. Survey rankings show importance, not probability.

name: Overtime and long working hours
description: Working long hours or seven days a week reduces productivity and raises errors and absence.
evidence_note: M01 (India): working 7 days per week RII 0.741; M01 (India): frequency of working overtime RII 0.709; M10 (Middle East): working overtime RII 0.696; M06 (India): working hours RII 0.688. Survey rankings show importance, not probability.

name: Worker fatigue, age or personal problems
description: Tired, older or distracted workers lose output.
evidence_note: A02 (India): age RII 0.73 (related); M10 (Middle East): physical fatigue RII 0.723; M14 (Indonesia): personal problems RII 0.711; M14 (Indonesia): fatigue RII 0.612. Survey rankings show importance, not probability.

name: Poor communication or misunderstanding on site
description: Instructions are misunderstood between labourers, supervisors and management.
evidence_note: M01 (India): poor relation between labour and superintendents RII 0.755 (related); M06 (India): social skills of key team managers RII 0.692 (related); M10 (Middle East): problem of communication RII 0.682; A02 (India): misunderstanding among labourers RII 0.68. Survey rankings show importance, not probability.

name: Poor labour discipline or weak site leadership

evidence_note: A15 (Sri Lanka): poor labour discipline RII 0.79; M06 (India): leadership qualities RII 0.752 (related); M01 (India): bad leadership skill RII 0.75. Survey rankings show importance, not probability.

name: Inadequate training of workers
description: Workers lack the training needed for the masonry method in use.
evidence_note: M10 (Middle East): inadequate training RII 0.459. Survey rankings show importance, not probability.
